tangoVocab.name: N1-はじめての日本語能力試験Ｎ１単語 3000.pdf (アークアカデミー) (personal JLPT vocab book, extracted via Gemini vision, NOT an open/licensed dataset)
tangoVocab.url: n/a -- user-supplied PDF, extracted page-by-page via _scratch/gemini_tango_n1.py using Gemini vision (gemini-flash-lite-latest)
tangoVocab.usedFor: word, reading, partOfSpeech, Vietnamese meaning, and example sentence, all as printed in the source book (Vietnamese-only picked out of the book's Korean/Vietnamese bilingual meanings)

notes: The PDF's own cover page advertises an English/Chinese translation edition, but the actual page content is Korean+Vietnamese bilingual (2 separate lines: Korean then Vietnamese, no '/' separator) -- almost certainly a mismatched/mislabeled scan cover from this personal PDF's provenance, not a translation error on our part. Verified directly against the page images before writing the extraction prompt.

Despite the book's title/series claiming 3000 words (matching the same under-count pattern as the N2 book), the real numbered vocabulary list (単語No. 1-1852) tops out at 1852 -- verified against the source images (last entry 回す/1852 on the page right before the final unnumbered ことわざ/proverb reference section).
Unlike the N2 book, the trailing 'いろいろな意味を持つ言葉' (polysemous words) section IS part of the main numbered sequence here (entries ~1838-1852), not bonus/unnumbered content -- included in full.

Not extracted (bonus content, not part of the main numbered list): the '+' related-word / '=' synonym / hand-icon usage-note boxes attached to individual entries, the affix/idiom-themed 'これも覚えよう' column inserts embedded on regular pages, and the final unnumbered ことわざ (proverbs) reference section before the book ends.

partOfSpeech IS distinguished by the source book (small badge per entry: 名/動/イ形/ナ形/副/接続/連体/慣/感) and was mapped directly during extraction, same as vocab-tango-n2.json -- unlike tango-n3/n4/n5 which all use "Khac" uniformly. The idiom badge (慣, e.g. 気が置けない) is mapped to "Khac" since VocabPos has no idiom category.

Several entries are polysemous with multiple numbered senses (①②③...), each with its own example -- meaningVi and example/exampleVi preserve the ①②③ numbering inline rather than being split into separate cards.
hanViet/mnemonic left empty, matching tango-n2/n3/n4/n5 -- this source has no Han-Viet reading or mnemonic story in the original book.
